quaker.liturgy:
Many Friends practice waiting worship, also called silent meeting. The community gathers without a set order of service, a prepared sermon or a paid minister, and waits together in silence for the presence of God. Anyone who feels led by the Spirit may speak, briefly, and the others listen and hold the message in prayer.

The underlying conviction is that Christ teaches his people directly, so worship does not depend on a priest or a program. Not all Friends worship this way. Some Quaker meetings, particularly evangelical ones, have programmed worship with hymns, Scripture reading and a pastor's message. Where worship is unprogrammed, the silence is not empty. It is understood as an active waiting on the Lord.
quaker.pacifism:
Friends hold the peace testimony: the witness that Christ's way leaves no place for war or violence, and that Christians are called to live in a way that takes away the occasion for it. Friends have historically refused military service and worked instead for reconciliation, relief and justice.

It is called a testimony because it is understood as a way of living that bears witness to the kingdom of God, rather than as a rule imposed from outside. Many Friends apply it to daily conflicts as well as to war. Not all Quakers hold it in the same way. Some meetings treat it as central and binding, while others leave it to each member's conscience, and there have been Friends who served in the military.
quaker.oaths:
Friends do not take oaths. They understand Jesus' words in the Sermon on the Mount, and the teaching in the letter of James, to mean that a Christian's plain word should be enough: let your yes be yes and your no be no. To swear a special oath would suggest that a person is truthful only when under oath.

In courts and public life, Quakers ask to make a solemn affirmation instead, and many legal systems allow this. The testimony is really about truthfulness in all of life, not just refusal of a ceremony. Friends aim to speak the truth at every time, so that no additional promise is needed to guarantee it.
